fn solve(N: Int, S: Int, A: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (N >= 1)
  requires (S >= 1)
  requires (len(A) == N)
  requires (N <= 3000)
  requires (S <= 3000)
  requires forall i in 0..N: ((A[i] >= 1) and (A[i] <= 3000))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures (result < 998244353)
  ensures ((result % 998244353) == result)
  ensures ((not ((N == 1) and (S == A[0]))) or (result == (if (S == A[0]) then 1 else 0)))
  ensures ((not ((N == 1) and (S != A[0]))) or (result == (if (S == A[0]) then 1 else 0)))
  ensures ((not (forall i in 0..len(A): (A[i] > S))) or (result == 0))
  effects pure
  example (solve(0, 0, []) == 0)

  0
